laneRationale: The SDK and the driver are a matched pair speaking a private shared-memory dialect. Re-implementing the SDK half per persona meant re-deriving that dialect from source each time; this lane instead loads the exact pinned release SDK inside the elevated host boundary, the way PadForge consumes it, while the DualSense conformance persona stays on the audited candidate host.

supportedProfiles.buttonSemantics: layout-indexed mask (the Switch protocol packer indexes the raw mask by layout button indices; semantic flags would land Back on ZL)
semantic HMButton flags (the descriptor lane maps them through the profile buttonMap)

unsupportedProfiles.reason: the DualSense conformance persona is served by the audited candidate host, never by this lane

feedback: none in v1 — rumble decode (SwitchProPacker amplitude / descriptor output reports) is a recorded follow-up
sdkApiSurfaceNeverCalled: registry provisioning beyond what CreateController itself performs
